Container.Name: Narrare
Container.Overview: Local-first, AI-assisted creative writing. Bring your own model, cloud or local. REQUIRES an existing PostgreSQL that can CREATE EXTENSION vector (pgvector); this template starts no database of its own. Set NARRE_DB_* to reach yours, and keep NARRE_SECRET_KEY with your backups.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The interface and the API, on one origin.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_HOST
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of your PostgreSQL, as seen from this container. A Postgres container on the same Docker network answers to its container name.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_NAME
Config.Description: An existing, empty database. Narrare creates its own tables and the extensions its schema needs.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_USER
Config.Description: A user that may create tables and extensions in that database.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Leave empty for a server that trusts its local connections.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_PORT
Config.Description: PostgreSQL's port on the host above.

Config.Name: NARRE_DB_SSLMODE
Config.Description: Optional: disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca or verify-full. Empty means the driver's default.

Config.Name: NARRE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Generate once: docker run --rm --entrypoint /app/.venv/bin/python ghcr.io/jmerifjKriwe/narrare:latest -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())". It encrypts the provider keys you store in the app; a new one makes the old keys unreadable, so keep it with your backups.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where the dump taken before every schema upgrade lands. It must outlive the container.
